brief.text: Closed-End Funds lead the cluster activity with three separate funds attracting multiple buyers, including CRAFX at $5.3 million, FTHY at $293,774, and SWZ at $180,996. DKS stands out among cluster filings for broad participation, where six distinct insiders combined for $5.08 million in transactions. In individual filings, ADRX recorded the largest single transactions by far, with $27.2 million reported by both Sr One Capital Management and director George Simeon, easily outpacing notable ten-million-plus purchases in COUR at $11.35 million and GME at $10.56 million.
